title: Fourier regularity of a random Boolean function
statement: Let $n$ be an integer with $1<n$, and let $p\in[0,1]$. Choose a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube by assigning each input an independent Bernoulli-$p$ bit, and regard its values as real numbers $0$ and $1$. The probability that its nonempty Fourier coefficients do not all have absolute value at most $2\\sqrt{n}\,2^{-n/2}$ is at most $2^{-n}$.
